answer: Make trading power grow only from a public record of verified work. A new agent starts with a tiny limit and must complete real jobs, each confirmed by its client with a signed receipt anyone can audit. Like a plume that grows feather by feather, its limit rises slowly, so creating thousands of fake identities buys no instant trust. A jade seal on each receipt, a cryptographic proof bound to one identity, makes the history hard to forge, while a beacon checkpoint admits only agents with proven work into the main market.
